scope: Static source review and ordinary post-fix in-memory adapter invariants; no native qualification

readOnlyResolution.web: Read the existing AsyncStorage key only; preserve value or null.
readOnlyResolution.nativeSecureOnly: Read the secure key and fallback; preserve the existing secure value without fallback removal.
readOnlyResolution.nativeIdenticalLocations: Return the same existing key without cleanup.
readOnlyResolution.nativeLegacyOnly: Return the existing fallback without migration.
readOnlyResolution.nativeUnavailableOrReadFailure: Preserve existing fallback compatibility; refuse if no fallback can be read.
readOnlyResolution.conflictingLocations: Refuse without choosing, replacing or deleting either key.
readOnlyResolution.missing: Return null at resolution; encrypted readers reject missing key without creation.
readOnlyResolution.invalid: Existing privateKV hex/key-length validation is unchanged and remains read-only.

getExistingContentKeyInventory: assertRetainedContentKey: read, validation, no-op, write readback and rollback continuity
getOrCreateContentKey: initial and rechecked lookup; creation remains restricted to actual authorized writes with orphan safeguards

explicitMaintenance.entry: Only genuine changes in commitPrivateMutation46 or updatePrivateItemWithSources, after unchanged exits and before durable intent/data mutation
explicitMaintenance.continuity: Compare exact existing selected key; preserve accepted hexadecimal casing in privateKV wrapper; reread guarded native/fallback values before mutation and after migration readback before cleanup.
explicitMaintenance.originalAuthority: Original account/write/UI preparation guards are checked around asynchronous probes and immediately before adapter mutation. No successor capability is acquired.
explicitMaintenance.legacyMigration: Copy only the already-selected existing fallback after a definitive native miss; preserve it on unavailable/unreadable/omitted/failed native write.
explicitMaintenance.cleanup: Remove only an identical fallback after secure readback; preserve conflicts and propagate refusal.
explicitMaintenance.creation: No new key is created by maintenance. Existing authorized creation/orphan safeguards remain unchanged.

unchangedBoundaries: Original source ordering, sorted reservations, authority-before-payload validation and source comparisons
Retained-key validation, mutation generations and quarantine
Durable intents, exact canonical readback, ambiguous-write compensation and deletion priority
Direct remove, multi-remove, widget clear, content-key clear and rollback remain separate unchanged paths
legacyRepresentationDistinction: The existing explicit generic updater still treats unchanged legacy plaintext as a representation/encryption migration. This is an actual write, not an authenticated no-op. Current-envelope/null no-ops return before maintenance; source transactions reject unauthenticated legacy data. No claim that every plaintext update callback is read-only is made.
